summary.content:
Today's selection covers 58 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 37 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Centers Laboratory Data Breach Affects 540,000 Individuals
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 16 articles published in the last 24 hours
